0x007C4304.name: maybe_g_actorDisplayOffset

0x00766E7C.comment: Vtable of the Cutscene_Scene class: slot 0 creates the actor models, slots 1-5 are the scene's layout/script helpers and slot 6 is Cutscene_FindResourceEntry. Cutscene_Scene_Init stamps it into every new scene object and Cutscene_Scene_Dtor re-installs it before teardown.

0x007A2CFC.name: maybe_g_cutsceneToggleFlag
0x007A2CFC.comment: One-byte latch toggled between 0 and 1 by Cutscene_AdvanceTimeline while action bit 0x1000 is set in the input snapshot and the scene is in its alternate input mode. No other code reads or writes it, so it is a private per-scene toggle whose visible effect cannot be proven from this function.

0x007C34C0.name: g_cutSceneActorClassRecord
0x007C34C0.comment: Named class record for the 'CutSceneActor' actor type: three intrusive list words (+0x0..+0x8), a parent-class pointer (+0xC = 0x007C33D4) and a pointer to the ASCII name 'CutSceneActor' (+0x10). Field_RegisterCutSceneActorClasses creates it at startup and Cutscene_CreateActorModels / maybe_Event_Packet_AttachModel compare object class ids against it.

0x007C34D4.name: g_cutScenePlayerActorClassRecord
0x007C34D4.comment: Named class record for the 'CutScenePlayerActor' type, the player-controlled actor in a cutscene: parent pointer +0xC = 0x007C34C0 (CutSceneActor) and name pointer +0x10 = 'CutScenePlayerActor'. Field_RegisterCutSceneActorClasses creates it and Cutscene_CreateActorModels compares attachment class ids against it.

0x007C8608.name: maybe_g_listPanelClassRecord
0x007C8608.comment: Static class record for the four-row list-panel window class (vtable 0x00762FEC): +0xC parent descriptor 0x007E2000, +0x10 factory 0x0016274C (allocates the 0x60-byte object) and +0x14 an 'is instance' predicate 0x00315EBC. Built lazily by 0x0068B23C; Cutscene_ResolveActorResource compares an object's class id against it while resolving the scene's panel from the resource list.
